scripts.dev: npm run build:pricing && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @tripos/api" "npm run dev -w @tripos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:pricing && npm run build -w @tripos/api && npm run build -w @tripos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:pricing && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:pricing && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:pricing && npm run test:e2e -w @tripos/api
